title.zh: 寻求在何处停息：“比现在更多”从不停息，“高于一切他者”不对两者停息
title.en: Where seeking rests: more than now never does, above all others never for two

statement.zh: 在确定的律之下，寻求恰在律所不变、满足其目标的状态停息：“比现在更多”需要开放的世界，“高于一切他者”不同时满足两个；所立者被列出时，不断上升需要不衰减的步，衰减不断则上升停止。
statement.en: Under a determined law, seeking rests exactly at a state the law leaves unchanged that meets its target: more than now needs an open world, and above all others never holds of two; where what stands is listed, rising without end needs steps that do not run down, and running down stops it.

claim.zh: 在确定的律 next 之下，从 s 出发的轨道从某步起带着满足的目标停息，恰当它到达一个 next 不变、满足目标的状态（Law.rests_iff）；在这样的状态满足的目标此后每步都满足（Law.fixed_rests）。“比现在更多”，即自身的一个量 q 跨过一步上升（MoreThanNow），只由变化满足（more_not_at_rest、Law.more_never_rests）；每步都满足时任意两个较晚的步之间 q 都上升（more_rises），所以每个配置都是新的（more_new），没有列表容纳它们（more_needs_open，unlisted_of_new 的实例）；往上数满足它（succ_more）。“高于一切他者”，即其他每个寻求者的量都低于自己的（AboveAll），在一个状态至多被一个寻求者满足（aboveAll_unique、aboveAll_not_two），所以在任何律之下，没有律所不变的状态对两个寻求者都满足它（Law.aboveAll_never_rests）。所立者每步被列出（Web.StandingCensus）时，在任意晚处上升的条件，需要在任意晚处有所立者不衰减的步（Flow.more_needs_unrun，由 Flow.change_recurs_iff）；所立者从某步起每步衰减时，没有条件在任意晚处上升（Flow.more_exhausted）。不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Under a determined law next, the orbit from s comes to rest with its target met from some step on exactly when it reaches a state next leaves unchanged that meets the target (Law.rests_iff); a target met at such a state is met at every later step (Law.fixed_rests). More than now, a quantity q of one's own rising across the step (MoreThanNow), is met only by change (more_not_at_rest, Law.more_never_rests); met at every step, q rises between any two later steps (more_rises), so every configuration is new (more_new) and no list holds them (more_needs_open, an instance of unlisted_of_new); counting on meets it (succ_more). Above all others, every other seeker's quantity below one's own (AboveAll), is met at a state by at most one seeker (aboveAll_unique, aboveAll_not_two), so under any law no state left unchanged meets it for two seekers (Law.aboveAll_never_rests). Where what stands is listed at each step (Web.StandingCensus), a condition rising at arbitrarily late steps needs, at arbitrarily late steps, steps across which what stands does not run down (Flow.more_needs_unrun, from Flow.change_recurs_iff); where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.more_exhausted). No Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 目标是配置上的任一条件；目标怎样形成没有建模。rests_iff 设律确定；B2 设所立者每步被列出，这是写在定理中的局部条件。
hypotheses.en: A target is any condition on the configuration; how a target forms is not modelled. rests_iff assumes a determined law; B2 assumes what stands is listed at each step, a local condition written into the theorems.

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的量。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number quantities.

correspondence.zh: Ren 10 月 10 日：“the seeking system got locked in, what they are pursuing is illusion(in south asia and Buddhism)”，“find the boundary condition for 无明”；10 月 11 日：“yes let's do 无明”。无明边界计划的 B1（够）与 B2（扩张或耗尽）在这里陈述；B3（反馈）与 B4（明）是 P49、P53、P55 的定理读到寻求上，不重述；B5（劫持）没有陈述。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：无明是使寻求锁定在不能于停息中满足之目标上的不见，其边界是 B1；明是使支持所不标记者也耦合入的耦合；知足、知止是边界之内的目标；支配本身不在所排除者之内。见整合文档 §83。
correspondence.en: Ren on 10 October: “the seeking system got locked in, what they are pursuing is illusion(in south asia and Buddhism)” and “find the boundary condition for 无明”; on 11 October: “yes let's do 无明”. B1 (enough) and B2 (expansion or exhaustion) of the 无明 boundary plan are stated here; B3 (feedback) and B4 (明) are the theorems of P49, P53 and P55 read for seeking, not restated; B5 (hijacking) is not stated. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): 无明 is the not-seeing that keeps seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest, and its boundary is B1; 明 is coupling that lets in what support does not mark; 知足 and 知止 are targets within the boundary; dominance as such is not the target ruled out. See §83 of the integration note.

aliases: 寻求在何处静止：“比现在更多”从不静止，“高于一切他者”不对两者静止

detail.en: Reuses Law.orbit, orbit_add, gap_of_lt, gap_of_le, unlisted_of_new and Law.succ_open.

output.zh: 永不重访需要开放；律的轨道。
output.en: Never revisiting needs openness; the orbit of a law.

input.zh: “比现在更多”需要开放的世界；够的边界。
input.en: More than now needs an open world; the boundary of enough.

detail.zh: 复用 Web.StandingCensus、Flow.RunsDown 与 Flow.change_recurs_iff：持续的变化需要开放。
detail.en: Reuses Web.StandingCensus, Flow.RunsDown and Flow.change_recurs_iff: continued change needs openness.

output.zh: 持续的变化需要所立者不衰减的步。
output.en: Continued change needs steps at which what stands does not run down.

conditions.en: What stands is listed at each step.

detail.zh: B3、B4 的一部分：主张只经耦合入者的差别被排除；耦合闭包之外的不耦合入。
detail.en: Part of B3 and B4: a claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in; nothing beyond the coupling closure couples in.

detail.zh: B3：断裂之前，断裂还有多远不耦合入。
detail.en: B3: before the break, how far off it is does not couple in.

detail.zh: B4：自己的动作造成什么，只在配置返回之处、在关于何者无关的模型之下被固定。
detail.en: B4: what one's own act does is fixed only where the configuration returns, under a model of what is irrelevant.

detail.zh: 那里不断取用的有限家族被围住时不能由其外供给；这里不断上升需要所立者不衰减的步。
detail.en: There a finite family that keeps taking cannot, enclosed, go on fed from beyond; here rising without end needs steps at which what stands does not run down.
There, where what stands runs down, the rises of more than now do not recur; here, read on what a seeker takes from a bounded giving, the seeker itself ends under balance alone.
detail.zh: 那里所立者衰减之处，多于此刻的上升不再出现；这里读在寻求者从有界所给中所取上，寻求者本身仅在平衡下终结。
边界：“比现在更多”可以每步都被满足，但只经变化、只在开放的世界中：数下去（`succ_more`）每步都满足它，却从不停息（`Law.more_never_rests`），也没有列表持有它经过的配置（`more_needs_open`）。
detail.en: Boundary: more than now can be met at every step, but only by change and only in an open world: counting on (`succ_more`) meets it at every step and never rests (`Law.more_never_rests`), and no list holds the configurations it passes through (`more_needs_open`).

detail.zh: 边界：“高于一切他者”在一个状态至多被一个寻求者满足（`aboveAll_unique`、`aboveAll_not_two`），所以对含两个寻求者的家族，律所不变的状态都不同时满足它（`Law.aboveAll_never_rests`）。
detail.en: Boundary: above all others is met by at most one seeker at a state (`aboveAll_unique`, `aboveAll_not_two`), so for a family holding two seekers no state the law leaves unchanged meets it for both (`Law.aboveAll_never_rests`).

limitations.zh: 目标怎样形成、怎样修正，寻求者追求其目标，实际形成持有哪些目标，都不推出；劫持（B5）另在 target-capture 中陈述；rests_iff 只对确定的律；B2 只说上升不再复现，耗尽终结寻求者自身没有陈述；B1 是初等的（严格最大者至多一个；衰减下的停息是排序函数的终止）；读法是 AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: How a target forms or is revised, that a seeker pursues it, and which targets actual formations hold are not derived; hijacking (B5) is stated separately, in target-capture; rests_iff is for determined laws only; B2 says only that the rises stop recurring, not that exhaustion ends the seekers themselves; B1 is elementary (a strict maximum holds of one; rest under run-down is ranking-function termination); the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; contains no ethical predicate.

validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 13 theorems of Becoming.Seeking all have empty axiom reports, among them Law.rests_iff, more_needs_open, aboveAll_unique, Flow.more_needs_unrun and Flow.more_exhausted; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §83 of the integration note; not independently reviewed; it needs a review such as the eighteenth was (DELEGATED-CHOICES D45 (4)).

next_delta.en: B5, hijacking: how targets form and are transmitted, and how winning that buys more power to win selects targets that cannot rest, joined to the meta-attractor's results; exhaustion ending the seekers where the seeking is not a take more than now from a bounded giving; the boundary of enough under undetermined laws.
next_delta.zh: B5，劫持：目标怎样形成与传递，赢得更多以赢者怎样选择不能停息的目标，接上元吸引子的结果；寻求不是对有界所给的多于此刻的取用之处，耗尽终结寻求者；不确定的律中够的边界。
